check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点一下打卡。

dialogue.en: Next up is the Drova retry ticket. It's still pretty rough.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: rough 指 ticket 写得粗糙、不完整
dialogue.zh: 下一个是 Drova 重试的 ticket，现在还比较粗糙。

dialogue.en: Yeah, let me walk you through it. Basically we need retries when the Zookeeper connection drops.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: walk you through it 过一遍，讲 ticket 或设计的万能开场
dialogue.zh: 对，我来过一遍。简单说就是 Zookeeper 连接断掉时需要重试。

dialogue.en: How many retries are we talking about?
dialogue.speaker: Tom

dialogue.en: Good question. I'm thinking three, with exponential backoff. Does that sound reasonable?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: exponential backoff 指数退避，重音在 backoff
dialogue.zh: 问得好。我想的是三次，指数退避。你觉得合理吗？

dialogue.en: Three sounds fine. What happens if all three fail?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.zh: 三次可以。如果三次都失败呢？

dialogue.en: Then we log it and page the on-call. I'll add that to the acceptance criteria.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: page the on-call 呼叫值班人员；acceptance criteria 验收标准
dialogue.zh: 那就记日志并呼叫 on-call。我会把这条加到验收标准里。

dialogue.en: Can you also spell out what 'done' looks like? Right now it's kind of vague.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: spell out 讲清楚、列明白；what 'done' looks like 完成标准
dialogue.zh: 你能把完成的定义写清楚吗？现在有点模糊。

dialogue.en: Sure. Done means retries work, failures get logged, and we've got a test for the drop scenario.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.zh: 没问题。完成的标准是：重试能工作、失败有日志、断连场景有测试覆盖。

dialogue.en: Do we need to worry about duplicate messages on retry?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.zh: 重试会不会导致消息重复？需要担心吗？

dialogue.en: Oh, good catch. Yes, we do. Let me add idempotency to the ticket as well.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: good catch 表扬对方发现问题，grooming 高频表达
dialogue.zh: 哦，抓得好。是的，我把幂等也加到 ticket 里。

dialogue.en: Great, this is in much better shape now. Anything else before we move on?
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 很好，现在清楚多了。还有别的吗？

dialogue.en: I think we're good. I'll update the ticket right after the meeting.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: I think we're good 我们没问题了，收尾常用
dialogue.zh: 我觉得可以了。会后我就更新 ticket。

key_phrases.en: Let me walk you through it.
key_phrases.note: 讲 ticket 或设计的万能开场
征求意见，比 do you agree 更柔和
肯定别人的发现，拉近距离

key_phrases.en: Can you spell out what 'done' looks like?
key_phrases.zh: 能把完成标准写清楚吗？

key_phrases.en: I'll update the ticket right after the meeting.

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS，每句跟读 2 遍，注意疑问句的升调
背诵 5 分钟：遮住英文，只看中文说出英文
模拟 5 分钟：挑一个你 backlog 里的真实 ticket，用英文讲一遍它要做什么、完成标准是什么
roleplay_zh: 你是 grooming 的 ticket owner：用英文介绍一个真实 ticket，讲清楚背景、方案和完成标准，并回答一个追问。
scene_zh: 梳理 backlog 里的 ticket，把需求讲清楚、补上验收标准，让 ticket 达到可排期的状态。目标是消除模糊地带，planning 时不再返工。
title: Backlog Grooming
